name: gemini-smoke

ladder.why: the cheapest Gemini: this only checks that headless Antigravity can read, list, write and run its gate

gates: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const n=fs.readdirSync('examples/trains').filter((f)=>f.endsWith('.json')).length; const t=fs.readFileSync('smoke/report.md','utf8'); if(!t.includes('git-trains')||!t.includes(String(n))){console.log('expected git-trains and '+n+' in: '+t);process.exit(1)}"
